props.title: Top Trends in Playground Design
props.summaryText: What is changing in playground design in India: nature play, inclusion, culturally rooted designs, adventure towers, play combined with fitness, and smarter use of colour and space.
props.author: rohan-mehta
props.imageAlt: Play towers with roofs and slides against an evening sky

takeaways.text: Nature-inspired and natural play is replacing generic plastic-and-pipe designs.
Inclusive design is moving from a special corner to the whole playground.
Designs rooted in Indian games and culture are growing.
Play areas increasingly combine children's play, adult fitness and seating in one space.

faq.q: What are the latest trends in playground design?
faq.a: Nature-inspired and natural play, inclusive design throughout the playground, culturally rooted designs, adventure towers and nets, play combined with outdoor fitness and seating, games built into coloured surfaces, and compact designs for podiums and small spaces.

faq.q: Why is inclusive design important in playgrounds?
faq.a: Inclusive design lets children of different abilities play together, which benefits every child and the wider community, and is increasingly expected in public and institutional spaces.
Themes give children a story to play into and make a play area memorable. They work best when the theme suits the setting and the equipment still offers good play value.
